verdict.rationale: CT Corporation offers compliance and entity-management services, and products of that kind could plausibly offer workflow automations with versioning and rollback, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes: the main host returned a Cloudflare challenge, and the legacy host redirects into that walled host. No page content describing automations, version history, review, or rollback was reachable, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.
